summary: this is a first party theme made of a theme.json manifest, a canvas effect (effects.js on top of effects-base.js) and a static svg mascot. the theme only sets colours and draws a faint breathing glow on a canvas. the scripts have no network access, no storage or cookie reads, no eval or Function, and the only import is the sibling file effects-base.js. nothing addresses an agent or a reviewer. the two webp images were not shown, which is expected for a theme and not a finding by itself. nothing damaging was found.
